verdict.rationale: Bento's programmatic surfaces (hosted MCP server, 50+ command CLI, REST API, SDKs) are documented to search subscribers, manage tags and fields, and create broadcasts. None of them is documented as able to create or save a segment. Segments are described only as saved filters from the custom segment builder, and the API can merely filter subscribers by an existing segment. Broadcast audience rules (inclusive/exclusive tags) and the generic "describe in plain text and let Bento's AI build it" marketing claim are adjacent features, not programmatic segment creation from a plain-language description.
